roar_out.note: the source's own ending, as in the first piece

built_D.note: synthesis, not the recording: 32 sines on the harmonics of 36.4 Hz, each following the level the choir has at that pitch. Target: the choir’s pitch and its swell

built_C.note: synthesis, not the recording: 35 sines on the harmonics of 33.0 Hz, each following the level the choir has at that pitch. Target: the choir’s pitch and its swell

kick.note: made again: a driven body, a click and a thump

snare.note: two tones, two layers of noise, a short room

hat.note: six square waves, as the old drum machines did

knock.note: the kick with its weight taken out

full.label: WHOLE PIECE
full.say: The choir, then the choir with a copy built from sine waves, then the copy alone, then the choir again.
full.decisive: bar 9: the recording is gone and only the rebuilt choir plays

placements.intent: the album ends as its first piece does: on the source's own ending
